prostitutes.line: All the donuts have names that sound like prostitutes
stanza: Most of the imagery is from New York. It’s just that I was on 9th and… Well, it…
All the donuts have names that sound like prostitutes
And the moon's teeth marks are on the sky
Like a tarp thrown all over this
And the broken umbrellas like dead birds
The steam comes out of the grill
Like the whole goddamned town's ready to blow
